en: A black-and-white image of a mural or fresco painted on the vaulted wall above a decorated, gothic-style doorway. The mural depicts a lively scene with many figures dressed in historical European Renaissance or medieval clothing, possibly townsfolk, nobles, and other characters. Above one group, a sign reads 'Rathskeller,' and two women and a child look out from a window. The bottom of the mural includes the inscription: 'Savlia Lielgsheidt Chnain benden EBGELEY.' The surrounding architecture and decor have ornate, patterned designs.
